title: leucas decemdentata var. angustifolia
intro: Leucas decemdentata var. angustifolia, commonly known as the Narrow-leaf Leucas, is a plant species belonging to the family Lamiaceae. This plant is valued for its medicinal properties, which include potential health benefits such as antioxidant, anti-inflammatory, and antimicrobial activities. The Narrow-leaf Leucas is reported to have therapeutic actions like wound healing, anti-diabetic, and anti-cancer properties. Its bioactive constituents include flavonoids, terpenoids, and phenolic acids, which are responsible for its medicinal properties.
